answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by gating task routing on proven throughput. New identities start in a sandbox of graded tasks. Step one: each task earns a receipt scored by two auditors. Step two: paid work unlocks after 100 tasks at 95 percent quality in 14 days. Step three: a dip below 90 percent sends the identity back to the sandbox. To forge 20 fake identities takes 2,000 graded tasks, 14 days of compute each and $3,000 in GPU time, for pennies of reward. Like a willow that bends but holds, the network flexes around attackers while every badge, as sable as midnight, stays earned.
